Mailgun (by Sinch) is a transactional email API platform offering message send, inbound routing, suppression management, list management, webhooks, and event analytics. The HTTP API uses HTTP Basic Authentication with the literal username `api` and the account API key as the password. Regional endpoints are available for US (`api.mailgun.net`) and EU (`api.eu.mailgun.net`) data residency.
